Architecture and eval reviews

Consulting · for agent systems you already run

A second pair of eyes on the agent system you already run.

Email me See CentrOS

For teams with agents live or close to it who want to know where they will break before a customer finds out. I read the code, the traces and the evals, and come back with findings ranked by risk and the order to fix them in.

What I look at

5

  1. Reliability and failure modesWhere runs fail silently, what retries hide, and whether a crash mid-run can be resumed or rolled back.
  2. Evals and regression gatesWhether your evals catch the regressions you care about, and whether anything blocks a bad prompt or model change from shipping.
  3. ObservabilityTraces over cost, latency and failure modes, and whether an on-call engineer could explain a bad run from them.
  4. Token costModel routing, prompt design, context packing and caching, with the savings estimated per change.
  5. Tool permissions and approvalsScopes on every tool, idempotency, audit logs, and which actions should wait for a human.

What you get

4

  1. 1. Written findingsEach issue with evidence, its risk and a concrete fix, ranked by impact.
  2. 2. An eval planThe cases and gates your system is missing, ready to add to CI.
  3. 3. Quick wins vs structural workWhat to fix this week, and what needs a design change.
  4. 4. A walkthroughA call with your team to go through the findings and answer questions.
